title: A hybridization-derived interior penalty Nitsche method for heterogeneous and anisotropic diffusion
summary: We develop an interior penalty Nitsche finite element formulation for heterogeneous and anisotropic diffusion problems, which is derived from an interior-penalty stabilized Lagrange multiplier method. A distinctive feature of the derived method is that it simultaneously combines two popular stabilization strategies: (i) a boundary penalty mechanism similar to Nitsche's methods and (ii) an interior penalty mechanism as for Continuous Interior Penalty (CIP) methods. Furthermore, the normal component of the numerical flux is single-valued across the mesh skeleton and available in closed form.…
